name: Custom Secure Login Register
author: imminentsoftware

sections.description:
A simple, responsive plugin for login, registration, password reset and email notifications with support for AJAX, reCAPTCHA, and redirection.

Features

  1. Automatic Page Setup

– Upon plugin activation:

- Login, Reset Password, and Logout pages are automatically created.

- Each page comes pre-loaded with the relevant shortcode.
  1. Display Options

– Admins can display the login/register form using:

a. Shortcode:
– Simply add [customsecurelr_login_register] to any page or post.

b. Popup Modal Trigger:
– Add the class customsecurelr-popup-trigger to any , , or menu item to open the form as a popup.

  1. Plugin Settings Tabs

– All settings are grouped under four intuitive tabs in the WordPress admin panel:

- General

- Actions & Redirections

- Emails

- Security (Captcha)
  1. General Settings

– Option to show/hide the registration form on the frontend.

  • Toggle display of First Name and Last Name fields.

  • Add unlimited Custom Registration Fields:

    • Field Types: Text, Number, Email, Dropdown.

    • Mark fields as Required.

    • Easily Add/Remove fields as needed.

All custom field data is securely stored in the WordPress database.

  1. Actions & Redirection Settings

– Redirect to:

# After Login:

- Homepage

- Custom URL

- Reload current page

# After Registration:

- Auto-login and redirect to Homepage

- Redirect to Custom URL

- Reload current page and show success message

# After Logout:

- Redirect to:

- Homepage

- Custom URL
  • All redirection behavior is fully configurable from the backend admin settings.
  1. Email Notification Settings

– Built-in customizable templates for:

- User Registration Email

- Lost Password Email

- Admin Notification Email

  • Enable/Disable Admin Email Notifications

  • Use Dynamic Tags/Shortcodes in email templates:

    • User Info: {username}, {email}, {first_name}, {last_name}, {password}

    • Site Info: {site_url}, {home_url}, {login_url}, {reset_password_url}

  1. Security (Google reCAPTCHA)

– Enable/Disable Google reCAPTCHA for login and/or registration forms.

  • Supports reCAPTCHA v2 (checkbox) and v3 (invisible).

  • Settings available:

    • Site Key & Secret Key fields

    • Selection of reCAPTCHA version

    • Enable per-form (login / register) control

    • Helpful link to register your site with Google reCAPTCHA

reCAPTCHA script loads only when necessary, improving page performance.

  1. Responsive & Optimized UI

    • Sleek, modern design

    • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly

    • Lightweight and fast-loading

    • Seamlessly integrates into any WordPress theme

    Summary

    • This plugin provides a complete frontend user authentication system with:

  • AJAX-based login/register/reset

  • Dynamic redirection settings

  • Email customization with placeholders

  • Custom field management

  • Clean and professional UI

  • Built-in Google reCAPTCHA for added security

External Services

This plugin uses Google’s reCAPTCHA service to prevent spam and abuse.

It sends the user’s reCAPTCHA token to Google’s servers during login and registration forms for verification purposes.

Service Provider: Google
Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/loginregistration-form/’ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the shortcodes or popup trigger to display login/register forms.
